title: Tasks
description: Everything open across every project on this host.
filterPlaceholder: Filter by id, title or label
needsDatabaseHint: They are Portta's own rows, persisted rather than observed. Start PostgreSQL and they come back.
emptyFiltersHint: Create one with New task, or widen the filters.
emptyListHint: A task exists without GitHub. Create one here, from the CLI with portta tasks create, or bind a GitHub issue later.
moreHidden: {{count}} more; narrow the filters to see them
confirmDelete: Delete task #{{id}}? Its subtasks go with it. A bound GitHub issue stays where it is.

status.fromLabel: on GitHub this status is a status: label, so changing it adds one label and removes another

dialog.localDescription: A task is Portta's own. Bind it to a GitHub issue afterwards if you want it there too.
dialog.boundDescription: This task is bound to a GitHub issue: the change is written there first, then here.
dialog.title: Title

detail.noSubtasksHint: Split the work by repository when several are involved; each subtask can point at its own.
detail.noSessionsHint: An agent announces itself with portta sessions start --task {{id}}; the session lists here with its commits.
detail.noEnvironments: No environment is running for this task
detail.noEnvironmentsHint: Name one after it (branch task-{{id}}-…, namespace suffix task{{id}}, or label portta.task) and the panel links it; or link one by hand.
detail.notePlaceholder: Leave a note a person or an agent will read
detail.startAndTakeHint: Moves this task to In progress and puts your name on it as the assignee.
detail.sendToReviewHint: Moves this task to Review. It stays assigned to whoever has it.
detail.markDoneAndClose: Mark done and close the issue
detail.markDoneAndCloseHint: Moves this task to Done and closes {{issue}} on GitHub.
detail.reopenHint: Moves this task back to In progress. A closed GitHub issue is not reopened from here.
detail.executionHint: Portta does not launch agents. An agent announces its own session with portta sessions start --task {{id}}, and it shows here while it runs.

github.conflictExplained: GitHub now says: "{{title}}", status {{status}}, assignee {{assignee}}. Keep what is here, or take what GitHub has.
github.commentPlaceholder: Comment on the issue (written to GitHub, never stored here)
github.notBound: Not bound to a GitHub issue. Everything here is local.
github.publishNeedsRepository: Point the task at a repository with a GitHub remote first
github.publishNeedsTitle: Give the task a real title before publishing it to GitHub

table.caption: Tasks, their state and who is on them
table.title: Title

pickProjectHint: A task belongs to one project. Repositories, environments and services come from the one you pick.
noProjects: No project to put a task in
moveFailedHint: The change was undone because the server refused it.

attachments.title: Attachments ({{count}})
attachments.emptyHint: Drop a file here, paste a screenshot, or choose one. Up to {{max}} MB each.
attachments.removeImpact: The file is deleted from this task and cannot be recovered.
